Question 5
?

Which of the following is equivalent to (n−2)! for any n≥4?

a
(n−2)⋅(n−3)⋅(n−4)!
b
(n−2)⋅(n−3)⋅⋯⋅4
c
(n−2)⋅(n−3)
d
(n−2)⋅(n−4)!
e
(n−2)⋅(n−3)⋅(n−4)
